author: Salah_danger
quote: The game has nothing to do with the gta we grew up to love and enjoy, it includes stuff that shouldn't be in any game like doing chores running errands, taking care of a virtual girlfriend that by the way dumped you years ago without notice, what does this game teach the generation? To be a pathetic man or what? Also the gameplay is not fun the graphics are nothing impressive for a 2026 game and it is 30 effing fps that dips to the low 20s in heavy action sequences or even when you're just around npcs, this game is the disappointment of the century
